# Sell 100 USD from a basis that cost 1.35, but value it at 1.20. Refused:
# valuing what is sold at anything other than the basis's cost misstates the
# residual, which is the realized gain or loss.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 100 USD at the wrong cost"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.20"
		value: "-120.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis_a}"
	Assets:Bank 139.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "139.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
